subject.title: fix(sessions): cap in-memory session history to prevent unbounded growth

question: Should this PR land as a steady-state retained-history cap while unpaginated initialization and refresh can still materialize the full transcript?
rationale: The patch fixes the reported unbounded `sentHistory` growth, but its broader constrained-host OOM claim may imply a peak-memory guarantee that the current read path does not provide.

options.title: Accept focused scope
options.body: Merge after inspectable exact-head proof and track full-read peak memory separately if it remains observable.

options.title: Bound reads before merge
options.body: Extend unpaginated initialization and refresh to tail-read a bounded raw window before projection.

recommendation.title: Accept focused scope
recommendation.body: Merge after inspectable exact-head proof and track full-read peak memory separately if it remains observable.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work defines the unified snapshot and projection architecture affected by this scope decision.
